unusual_experiment.name: NON_UTF8_ARGV_BYTE_ROUNDTRIP_THROUGH_ENTITYOS_HOST_BOUNDARY
unusual_experiment.rollback: No persistent state; child exited and argv was discarded.

grf_collapse.observed_anchor: The exact downloaded EntityOS one-file artifact accepted a capability-gated host process request containing argv bytes A FF B and the child reconstructed the same 41ff42 bytes.
grf_collapse.generated_reality: The Python/EntityOS host CLI string boundary necessarily destroys non-UTF8 argv bytes before Linux process spawn.
grf_collapse.strongest_counter_reality: The Unix Python filesystem encoding/surrogateescape path can preserve otherwise undecodable argv bytes for round-trip back to the OS boundary.
grf_collapse.discriminator: Pass one non-UTF8 byte through the exact EntityOS host boundary and compare the child process os.fsencode(sys.argv[1]) bytes.
grf_collapse.promotion_limit: This does not establish canonical Clay Bytes, String, argv, ownership/lifetime, effect signatures or TypedIR/ClayVM transport semantics.

repo_evidence.clayvm_current_limit: ClayVM v1 frame arguments and runtime stack are Int/Bool only; compile_typed_ir rejects parameter types outside Int and returns outside Int/Bool.
repo_evidence.executable_ir_adapter_current_limit: Executable-TypedIR lowering admits Int literals/locals/call parameters/hostcall arguments only.

external_primary_evidence.pep_383: Python PEP 383 specifies surrogateescape so non-decodable POSIX command-line bytes can be represented in str and recreated as original bytes.
external_primary_evidence.python_os_docs: Python os/sys documentation describes filesystem encoding plus surrogateescape and os.fsencode/fsdecode round-trip behavior on Unix.

architecture_delta.delta: Do not solve canonical Clay argv by assuming the host transport is inherently lossy. Keep String text semantics separate from opaque Bytes semantics; integrate owned Bytes/type metadata into the existing canonical TypedIR -> single ClayVM path instead of adding a second host/runtime sidecar.
architecture_delta.strongest_counterhypothesis: A future non-Python backend or a different locale/encoding configuration may not preserve the same byte round-trip, so canonical Clay semantics must not depend on CPython surrogateescape behavior.
architecture_delta.falsifier: After real Clay Bytes integration, run canonical TypedIR -> ClayVM -> capability-gated process tests over opaque bytes and reject any backend where declared byte identity changes.
architecture_delta.rollback: No product code changed in this receipt; reject the architecture delta if canonical multi-backend evidence contradicts it.
